title: CI streamline: no duplicate re-runs of already-approved code; triage required checks by what a PR touches; measure before paid resources
note: Operator 2026-11-03 ~21:20Z: cut CI per PR, no checks on already-approved code, triage by importance, then measure. BASELINE (ESTIMATED, run wall-min from the Actions API incl. job queue): push-to-main 2026-11-02 13:43Z->11-03 21:19Z (100 runs each): guards 3355 (p50 24.6), pytest-run 2448 (48 cancelled), pytest-collect 882, repo-inventory 400. PR runs 11:06Z->21:07Z (100 each): pytest-run 2369 (p50 21.9), guards 1264 (p50 10.0). PR open->merge, 183 PRs merged in 24h to 21:20Z: p50 28.6 / p90 91.8 min (human n=57 p50 47.8 / p90 166.9; data-commit n=46 p50 26.2; research bookkeeping n=58 p50 25.7). PLAN: (1) drop push-to-main triggers of pytest-run/guards/pytest-collect/repo-inventory, scheduled 2h backstops; (2) shallow checkout in pytest-run+guards; (3) change-class map for guards+pytest-run; (4) affected-tests already exists on PRs (pytest_run_scope.py); (5) batch bookkeeping PRs -> next row; (6) update_pull_request_branch on stuck PRs. LANDED 2026-11-03 (MERGED; OBSERVED pending): #22737 (23:41Z; no push-to-main runs of pytest-run/guards/pytest-collect/repo-inventory; 2-h scheduled backstops: pytest-run full suite if HEAD ungraded, guards --all never cancelled; repo-inventory off PRs, daily on main), #22739 (22:55Z; .github/ci-change-classes.json: order-path/risk/sizing/gate config always full suite; data-only PRs run only readers of touched trees, 89/114/24/59 vs 225 files), #22740 (23:00Z; due-list reads scheduled backstop runs), #22745 (23:18Z; PI-20261103-BCZDXJNR-0002 no re-arm after deterministic producer_failed while script unchanged). CLOSED #22738 (blobless checkout): its own run measured checkout 4m56s/4m25s (no faster than the 2.2 min full-history median) and guards hit its 30-min timeout in check_manager_scope.py lazily fetching blobs; shallow checkout dropped (git-log readers). Item 4 (affected tests) already existed. Item 5 -> row CI-BATCH-BOOKKEEPING. Step 6 done 23:42Z: update_pull_request_branch on #22682 #22599 #22598 #22712 (Tier 2, manager merges); #22570 has a merge conflict (manager's register branch); #22713/#22710/#22742 already closed. OBSERVATIONS TO CLOSE: (a) first scheduled guards run at :29 on an even hour is green and cancelled=false; (b) pytest-run schedule tick decides covered/run correctly; (c) a data-only PR's pytest-run summary names the touched trees; (d) 6 h and 24 h re-measure (same pulls as baseline: run wall-min per workflow/event over 100 runs, PR open->merge over 24 h) vs baseline in this row's note. 24-H RE-MEASURE 2026-11-04 23:46Z (window: #22737 at 23:41Z 11-03 to now; ESTIMATED wall-min incl. queue, Actions API, 100 most recent runs per workflow/event). (1) Push-to-main runs of pytest-run/guards on main after the cut: 0 (all main runs are schedule/workflow_dispatch). (2) Backstops OBSERVED: guards 8 keeper-dispatched runs on main 09:01Z-23:22Z, all success (#22813 effective), plus 3 cron runs (06:46 ok, 16:27 ok, 22:03 FAILURE; the 23:22Z dispatch after it was green). pytest-run 10 keeper dispatches 00:50Z-22:48Z all success, cron fired 3x. (3) PR runs, last 100 (20:21Z-23:43Z, daytime peak): pytest-run p50 11.8 / p90 35.5 (baseline 21.9 / 46.4), 22 of 94 cancelled (superseded pushes); guards p50 9.2 / p90 16.2 (baseline 10.0 / 25.3), 24 of 95 failed (guards tripped by the PRs' own diffs; not classified). (4) PR open->merge, PRs opened AND merged after the cut, found in the 200 most-recently-updated closed PRs (may undercount): n=79 p50 19.6 / p90 123.4 (baseline n=183 p50 28.6 / p90 91.8). Human n=46 p50 44.7 / p90 144.2 (baseline 47.8 / 166.9); data-commit n=15 p50 13.4 (26.2); research bookkeeping n=14 p50 17.5 (25.7). Read: the automation/data paths roughly halved; the human tail did not move much, consistent with human PRs running the full or affected suite as before. NOT OBSERVED: a data-only PR summary naming its touched trees (indirect only: #22759 pytest-run 7 min). Remaining levers: CI-BATCH-BOOKKEEPING; PI-20261103-DMX6EY51-0001 (auto-merge disable); the 22:03Z scheduled guards failure is for the backstop's page/due-list to route. 2026-11-06 BACKLOG-DRAIN-20261106: RE-DATED to 2026-11-11. Observation due 11-11 (data-only PR summary naming trees; guards backstop green 7d).

observation.what: a data-only PR pytest-run job summary names the touched data trees (per-tree selection from .github/ci-change-classes.json), and the keeper-dispatched guards backstop on main stays green for 7 days
observation.how_to_check: open the pytest-run job summary of any automation/data-commit or research-results-batch PR merged after 2026-11-03T22:55Z; list guards.yml runs on main with event=workflow_dispatch
